Método da coleta: o jogo cria o ovo tira: Pickup method: the game creates the egg by taking several numbers from the generator, one after another (nature and shiny, IVs, inheritance). On every screen frame it also takes a number on its own; if that lands in the middle of the creation, the egg's following numbers shift by one and the egg comes out different. Where it lands varies: those are the four methods (Bred, Split, Alternate and Mixed, the PokeFinder ones; not verified on Switch). With "all", the search compares the four and shows each egg's method.

Tell what you got and the site finds which seed and frame advance you landed on, near the ones you had picked: the seed difference fixes the press at PRESS START (stage 1), and the frame advance difference fixes the press at CONTINUE (stage 2).
